cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Enter on My Side
cards.instruction: Recruit them into your side of a contest or bargain before the stakes become fully clear.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put on our quiz-team badge before I explain the final round. I taught you to look like a team before worrying about the questions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You ask about consequences sooner now. Good. We'll face that together once the badge is on; stand beside me as we practised.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I haven't agreed to face anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then agree to wear blue beside your old coach. You managed that at your first quiz. One small thing first; I'll explain the final round once they see our team.
